title: Melody Of Lost All
author: Boby Borah
text:
Heart carries
A sea every moment
Two rivers `re on the eyes
Silence is in her depth
Furore wave of sea has
A mischievous dream of
Losing in sky too.

Tell me
Who peeps in
The bosom of the Sea! Being a ruddy shelduck
It `s flowing constantly
For thousand years.

The lips buzz a
Meaningless song,
Pains decorates silently,
Two rivers flows in the eyes,
Lose rythum of life ,
A dust particle leads the path
The heart carries a river.
stanzas: The bosom of the Sea! Being a ruddy shelduck
Two rivers flows in the eyes,
A dust particle leads the path
